title: Atlas launch scrubbed from the records

tellings.quote: There was no Atlas launch that day. Well, goddamn well there was because Robert found the found the files from Vanderberg using that particular that particular launch in detail.

plain: Bob Jacobs, who says he was involved in the event, tells of an Atlas rocket launch in 1964 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. He says the official word was that no Atlas launch took place that day. He also says a man he names only as Robert later found Vandenberg's own launch files, which described that very launch in detail, so the record looks scrubbed.
